liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cassidy** (1 review): Listener enjoyed Cassidy, Althea, and Let It Grow, plus the pre-drums section [4]
- **Jam** (1 review): Highlights include the Portland Jam, which comes out of Terrapin Station [8]

## The recordings

- **gd81-08-15.severson.munder.11022.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 162 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording is awfully distorted, likely from over-recording, unlike the earlier Seattle show [3]
- **gd1981-08-15.aud.severson.91771.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 161 min; rated 3.17/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording is average compared to other era tapes; performance is decent with sloppy moments [4]

## Around the show

- Seeded to etree by Willie; run started in Salt Lake, sandwiched between Seattle and Eugene [12]
- First set pulses with energy; second set is more human but very good overall [5]
- First set pulses with energy; second set is more human but very good overall [6]
- Show demonstrates 1981 was fantastic; last peak this high before Berkeley shows [10]
- Second of three shows; Seattle was better, but this was pretty damn good [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd81-08-15.severson.munder.11022.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Nak 700's [1]. Also: Recorded by Mark Severson; distortion in first three songs; seeded by Willy [1]
- **gd1981-08-15.aud.severson.91771.flac16**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by David Minches; source: 3 Nak 700s with 2 carcoid, center omni head> Sony TC-D5 (2 Maxell UD XL-IIs) [2]
